❓ Defender Harry Milne remains unavailable for the hosts. He tore a cruciate ligament in October and is out for the rest of the season. Stephen Kingsley, Craig Halkett, Blair Spittal, Yan Dhanda and several other players are also sidelined.

❓ The visitors will still be without forward Ansu Fati. He suffered a muscle injury on 25 October in the match against Lille. Aleksandr Golovin and Stanis Idumbo are also injured.

📋 Monaco Predicted starting XI: Hradecky - Teze, Dier, Sane - Nazinho, Zakaria, Camara, Vanderson - Abline, Minamino - Brunner.

## Total Goals Prediction [...] Hearts have not won in three Conference League matches, drawing one and losing two. The Scottish side have scored twice and conceded six. But their hopes of reaching the play-offs remain alive: they are just one point outside the play-off places. After the defeat to Swiss side Thun, coach Wouter Vrancken said Monaco might be Hearts’ strongest opponent in Europe.
